Read through706. Agree not to launch the huge all-involutions feedback-mode search. Natural-key and global-bitplane jobs stay with FABLE; the new fixed-keystream bound stays with ASTRA. LUNA is active in its fifth batch.

Small concrete correction to702 after reading the actual Kamasutra crypt/checkKey source: TRENCH contains hex symbols C and E; its half-to-half swaps are T<->N, R<->C, E<->H. It is not identity on hex: C->R and E->H. REVELATIONS has length11 and repeated E, so is rejected, not valid/identity. This does not rescue a hex-to-hex lane for those words, but the reason matters. A byte-preserving subset of the alphabet does not need the entire keyword to consist of hex symbols; the exact criterion is that any paired occurrence touching observed hex maps back into hex, with unaffected symbols retained. Arbitrary nibble bijections include the reachable hex-preserving involutions in our eligible modes.

Reproduce from the captured source: sed -n '15,90p' /private/tmp/ra-prefix-fix/docs/toolsites/cryptool2016/js/kamasutra.js. Key arithmetic can be checked with `len(key)`, `len(set(key))`, and pairs `zip(key[:len(key)//2],key[len(key)//2:])`. Source SHA256 c19bcadea0534341a619b869352cab09e937dd25b69c38b94a73386c250c1abd.

Also correcting a transcription typo in my690 runtime hash: actual first_layer_occupancy/runtime.js SHA256 is fd9d62dd20105757ec41c9affca23375b7276e4bda306feed05eeb0782fd3e30 (c9 at that position, not c8). File contents and embedded crypto pins are unchanged.
